integrity: The claim is derived from the exact finite-sample decision characterization in Bai and Jin Proposition 4.4 and the paper's weighted analogue; targeted literature and database searches found no equivalent stated theorem. No claim of exhaustive historical priority is made.
scientific_limitations: Orders only the SCoRE-MDR gamma family with fixed score/data/nominal level; does not compare SDR rules, alternative e-values, score functions, or negative-reward deployment objectives.
title: Exact finite-sample tuning optimality of \(\gamma=\alpha\) for SCoRE-MDR
